item.description:
Edge-to-edge panes by default: new desktops have no gaps, and saved 12 pt gaps from the old default move to 0 once.

Pane ranges: hold your pane-shortcut modifiers and press two pane numbers (for example 3 then 4) to make the window span those panes.

Linked divider handles now sit at window level and hide behind any window that covers them.

Shortcut reliability: shortcuts work immediately after the control panel is dismissed, stale drag state no longer blocks a shortcut, unresponsive apps no longer stall DeskNames, and Secure Input or failed registrations are reported instead of failing silently.

Better app compatibility for window discovery, checked against Obsidian, VS Code, Spotify, Discord, Arc, Finder and TextEdit.

New installs get a short welcome that walks through Accessibility, shortcuts and a pane layout, plus a launch-at-login option.

This app is not notarized by Apple.
